repos_data.description: Transparent macOS disk cleaner — groups files by app, moves to Trash (never permanent). SwiftUI + Liquid Glass, built for macOS Tahoe.
Menu bar app that finds and frees the disk space dev build artifacts and caches hog on macOS. Free, open source, notarized, zero telemetry.
A native macOS app store for software that isn't on the App Store, backed by Homebrew Cask
A native, local macOS toolbox for screenshots, OCR, measuring, keep-awake, pointer tools, shortcuts, windows, workspaces, voice and MCP.

repo_meta_data.description: 📦 A macOS utility to seamlessly migrate applications to external storage and reclaim local disk space.【一款 macOS 工具，无缝迁移应用到外部存储并自动建立链接，释放宝贵的本地空间】
